Preparing can feel overwhelming.

Most candidates face the same four blockers.

You don't know your real level

Without regular feedback, it's hard to know if you're ready for exam day.

Teacher feedback is slow and costly

Waiting days for corrections and paying high fees blocks consistent practice.

Generic apps don't match TCF format

Most language apps aren't built around TCF Canada's specific structure.

You don't know what to fix next

Without clear guidance, you waste time on areas that won't move your score.

Practice All 3 TCF Writing Tasks

Each task tests different writing skills. Practise all three to be fully prepared.

TASK 1

Email

150–200 words

Write a personal or professional email responding to a specific situation.

Example: Write to a friend about changing your vacation plans.

Try TASK 1

TASK 2

Article

200–250 words

Write an informative article or report for a publication or organisation.

Example: Write an article about the benefits of public transportation.

Try TASK 2

TASK 3

Opinion Essay

300+ words

Develop and defend your viewpoint on a topic with clear arguments.

Example: Should cities ban cars from downtown areas?

Try TASK 3
